The program error comes from the forbidden-word checker. It flags the token "input", which appears in the comment `# --- input CS device`. I've renamed that comment and replaced the odd `vds=None or 0.6` with `vds=0.6`. The topology and budget are unchanged.

First-order checks of the current sizing against each spec:

| Spec | Requirement | Estimate | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Transimpedance gain | ≥ 112 dBΩ (≈398 kΩ) | Rf = 440 kΩ, loop gain A0 > 10 | Meets |
| Bandwidth | ≥ 48 MHz | ωn ≈ √(gm1/(Co·Rf·Cin)) → about 50 MHz | Tight |
| Noise at 1 MHz | ≤ 270 fA/√Hz | Rf thermal alone ≈ 194 fA/√Hz | Meets |
| Power | ≤ 54 µW | ≈ 49.5 µW | Meets |
| Output DC level | 0.3 V to 1.5 V | ≈ 0.45 V | Meets |

The bandwidth estimate uses gm1 = gm/Id × I1 = 20 × 12 µA = 240 µS, Co ≈ 10 fF and Cin ≈ 0.5 pF. The output follower is matched to the feedback follower, so vout tracks the M1 gate voltage.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # CS gain device, weak/moderate inversion for gm per uA
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "I1":    (12e-6, 7e-6, 15e-6),
    "Rf":    (440e3, 400e3, 560e3),
    "gmidp": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS load
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidf": (14.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # followers
    "If2":   (8e-6, 5e-6, 11e-6),    # output follower (drives CL)
    "If1":   (1.5e-6, 1e-6, 3e-6),   # feedback follower (drives Rf only)
    "Ipb":   (1.0e-6, 0.5e-6, 2e-6), # PMOS bias branch
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    Lf, Lm, gmid_m = 0.5, 1.0, 12.0

    # --- gain CS device: DC gate level set by feedback (Vg = Vfb)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], p["I1"], vds=1.1)
    vg = m1.vgs
    # followers (bulk at vss -> body effect at vsb = vg)
    mf1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidf"], Lf, p["If1"], vds=VDD - vg, vsb=vg)
    mf2 = lut.size("n", p["gmidf"], Lf, p["If2"], vds=VDD - vg, vsb=vg)
    vo1 = vg + mf2.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], p["I1"], vds=vo1)
    # PMOS load and its diode reference
    mp1 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], p["I1"], vds=max(VDD - vo1, 0.2))
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], p["Ipb"], vds=mp1.vgs)
    # NMOS mirror from ibias
    mb  = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb  = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    ms1 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, p["If1"], vds=vg)
    ms2 = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, p["If2"], vds=vg)
    mnp = lut.size("n", gmid_m, Lm, p["Ipb"], vds=max(VDD - mpd.vgs, 0.3))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MNP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnp)
    n.dev("MPD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("M1",  "o1", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MP1", "o1", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp1)
    n.dev("MF1", "vdd", "o1", "fb", "vss", mf1)
    n.dev("MS1", "fb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ms1)
    n.dev("MF2", "vdd", "o1", "vout", "vss", mf2)
    n.dev("MS2", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ms2)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "fb", p["Rf"])

    # --- analytic model
    Rf = p["Rf"]
    A0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + mp1.gds)
    Ro = 1.0 / (m1.gds + mp1.gds)
    Co = m1.cdd + mp1.cdd + mf1.cgd + mf2.cgd + 0.2 * (mf1.cgg + mf2.cgg) + 2e-15
    Cg = cpd + m1.cgg
    Cf = m1.cgd
    def fgain(m, gl):
        return m.gm / (m.gm + m.gmbs + m.gds + gl)
    Af1 = fgain(mf1, 1.0 / Rf + ms1.gds)
    Af2 = fgain(mf2, ms2.gds)
    gout2 = mf2.gm + mf2.gmbs + mf2.gds + ms2.gds

    f = np.logspace(4, 9.5, 3000); s = 2j * PI * f
    A = A0 / (1 + s * Ro * Co)
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    vg_i = 1.0 / (s * Cg + Yf * (1 + Af1 * A))
    vout_i = -A * vg_i * Af2 / (1 + s * cl / gout2)
    mag = np.abs(vout_i)
    zt = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < zt / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = f[idx[0]] if len(idx) else f[-1]

    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = 4 * kT * (2.0 / 3.0) * (m1.gm + mp1.gm) / m1.gm ** 2
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * ((w * Cg) ** 2 + (1 / Rf) ** 2)
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    vout_dc = vg
    power = VDD * (iref + p["Ipb"] + p["I1"] + p["If1"] + p["If2"])

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "in_noise_1m": in_noise}
```
